column1: # 4 MB Super Mini layout — single factory app (no dual OTA).
# Dual OTA needed two 1.625 MB slots; the radio image is ~1.81 MB and cannot
# fit. One factory partition takes the space of both former OTA slots.
# www + config stay at the same offsets so a USB app-only flash still keeps
# the web UI and settings. Firmware updates are USB / serial only.
# coredump  0x012000   0x00E000   56 KB (fills hole before 64 KB-aligned factory)
